reviews.review: This fun, visceral third-person action game, is very true to its WH40K license. It sports massive violence, silly but serviceable plot, a genuinely satisfying, meaty combat and a horde of enemies to kill. It is rather repetitive though, and could get somewhat boring-ish after a few hours. Still, I'd recommend this game, if not for one fatal(for me at least) flaw - it has low FOV which cannot be fixed at all. I literally cannot play Space Marine for longer than half an hour per session due to nasty eye strain. You should totally try it out if you're okay with low FOV, but if you're like me - stay away.

This is a game you play for when you want to turn your brain off and bulldoze your way through hordes of enemies. The game stays true to the source material and really makes you feel the part of an Adeptus Astartes. The sounds are great, the visuals are acceptable (though given the games location, I was pleasantly surprised with how they created variety), the story is pretty standard for a Warhammer 40K title with a twist that I admittedly didn't see coming, but where this game truly shines is in the combat.

The guns are all fun, mostly portable with a couple turret sections scattered here and there, though eventually you find the ones that you stick with for the remainder of the game, *cough* Lazcannon *cough*. The melee weapons and the jump pack though are the ones that make you feel like an angel of death with the Chainsword, Power Axe, and Thunder Hammer all available for use. Executions are both the most satisfying and bloody kills you can get, but also the way you get health back something especially important on the higher difficulties.

Ultimately, this is a fantastic title which offers a surprisingly challenging campaign on Hard and all the blood and gore you could ever want.

then makes you look like a fool

then you play online

now you are all of those at once
Pretty much one of the greatest Warhammer 40k games out there, next to Dawn of War.

Have fun recreating Warhammer 40K battles in a slaughter against hordes of Orks. Best to play with friends online, that's where all the real fun is and it is so relaxing to play after all the competitive rage games. Of course its bloody good, it uses the 40K miniatures and they're all detailed and animated very well. There's some problems in that it states different statistics  to Fire Warrior (my only other 40K fps) such as the ammo count in the bolter but it doesn't matter.
